# The 20%-of-value rule can bid you past your own break-even before you've paid for a dump run.

> Free calculator for storage-unit auction bidders: prices the buyer's premium, realistic resale recovery, resale fees, dump and labor cost, and holding cost, then reports the bid a target margin supports, the break-even bid, and what a flat percent-of-value rule of thumb would have told you to bid instead.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
